system.description: A round light-blue gem that lets the bearer read the aura of a target within 20 m by concentrating and rolling Wisdom + Perception against TN 10. Success gives vague impressions of the strongest emotion; two or more raises show the target's emotions and whether they are Exalted. A suspicious target may resist with Willpower + Arcana, their result becoming the TN.
system.effectText: Read a target aura within 20 m: Wis+Perception TN 10, more raises reveal more (e.g. Exalted).
